show.description: Kiara Bharadwaj, who discovers on her 18th birthday that she was adopted by Arjun and Natasha Bharadwaj. What begins as a shocking revelation soon pulls her into a dark journey to uncover the truth about her real parents, Karthik and Kavita Verma, and a hidden past that threatens her very identity. With her best friend Saanvi Shukla and estranged sister Aadhya Kumari by her side, Kiara must decide where her true family lies in blood, or in love. Watch Now
